headings.usage: Use for all primary headers, tab titles, and numbers/metrics. Tight letter spacing (`tracking-tight`) for sizes > 32px. DO NOT use generic fonts like Inter for headings.

body.usage: Use for transcripts, form labels, and body copy. Highly legible for dense medical data.

colors.archetype: Organic & Earthy + Swiss Precision (Clean, Authoritative, Trustworthy)

palette.surface: #FFFFFF (Pure White) - For cards and readable areas
palette.primary: #064E3B (Emerald-900) - For primary actions, bottom nav active states, and clinical authority
palette.accent: #10B981 (Emerald-500) - For AI Insights and positive indicators
palette.text_primary: #0F172A (Deep Slate) - High contrast against light backgrounds

rules: No full-screen gradients. Keep the UI flat and clinical.
Maintain a minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio for all text.
Never use pure black or pure gray; always tint greys slightly with slate/blue.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use flat solid surfaces. NO GLASSMORPHISM. Medical apps require optical clarity to prevent visual refraction of data. Use warm solid backgrounds with subtle 1px borders.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid borders (`border-slate-200`) on cards and containers. Very subtle border radius (`rounded-xl` or `rounded-2xl` for mobile containers).
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal. Use ambient drop shadows only on floating elements like sticky bottom nav or action sheets (`shadow-[0_4px_24px_rgba(0,0,0,0.06)]`).
visual_enhancers.touch_targets: CRITICAL: Minimum touch target size of 48x48px for all interactive elements to accommodate users wearing medical gloves.

components_and_layout.layout_strategy: Mobile-First Progressive Web App (PWA). Wrap the main app inside a container (e.g., `max-w-md mx-auto`) with a fixed bottom navigation bar on desktop to preserve the mobile feel.
components_and_layout.navigation: Bottom Navigation Bar is MANDATORY for the PWA structure. Include: Record (Center/Prominent), Upload, Transcripts, Settings. Must have a safe-area inset at the bottom.
components_and_layout.home_screen: Extremely simple. Focus on a massive 'Record' button (circular, heavily padded, pulsing when active) and 'Upload Audio' secondary action.
components_and_layout.post_processing_tabs: Use a scrollable horizontal tab list or standard Tab component for: Transcript | Summary | AI Insights | Translation. Ensure the active tab has a high-contrast underline or solid background pill.
components_and_layout.cards: Cardless layout where possible, or flat cards with 1px border. Do not overuse Shadcn 'Card' with heavy shadows. Use `div` with padding and borders.
components_and_layout.mode_selector: Pill-shaped toggle group (General, Meeting Minutes, Medical/Clinical, Lecture, Interview). Must be horizontally scrollable on mobile.

motion.philosophy: Functional and reassuring. Avoid distracting animations.
motion.recording: Subtle Framer Motion pulsing ring (`scale` and `opacity`) on the active record button.
motion.transitions: Smooth fade (`opacity: 0` to `opacity: 1`) between the 4 main tabs.
motion.toasts: Use `sonner` for all notifications (e.g., 'Audio processed', 'Transcript saved').

accessibility.contrast: Adhere strictly to APCA / WCAG AA contrast rules.
accessibility.attributes: CRITICAL: All interactive elements MUST include `data-testid` attributes (e.g., `data-testid="record-button"`, `data-testid="tab-transcript"`).

images.description: Blue abstract sound wave on black
images.category: Use sparingly as a background accent in the 'Recording' state or 'AI Insights' hero section if a dark mode / high-contrast block is needed.
Authentication screen background or Welcome screen header imagery.

media.icons: Use `lucide-react` for all icons. Standardize stroke width to 1.5 or 2.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a Mobile Web App (PWA) using React (.js files) and Tailwind CSS.
Ensure the layout mimics a native mobile app. Use a fixed bottom navigation bar and scrollable main content areas (`overflow-y-auto`, `pb-24` to clear the nav).
Do NOT use HTML-based components for advanced interactions. Use Shadcn UI (modified for flat design).
Do NOT center align the entire app container text. Keep text left-aligned for reading transcripts.
All components must be written in `.js` (JSX), NOT `.tsx`.
Avoid using glassmorphism. Stick to solid backgrounds with sharp, accessible contrasts.
Add `data-testid` to all buttons, tabs, inputs, and links.
Ensure 'Medical/Clinical' mode and other modes are selectable easily via horizontal scrolling pills.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., `transition: all`). Use specific transitions.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, i.e., do not add `.App { text-align: center; }`.
Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped or sharp) with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖, 🧠) for icons. Use proper SVG icons (lucide-react).
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
